claims.statement: The fragment describes browser authentication for an HTTPS clone in its credential-manager context, possible OAuth authorization, and a required 2FA challenge when account or organization policy requires it. This is not a universal authentication contract for all Git transports or proof of consent or successful authentication.

Outside GHES, the managed-user tip recommends locally disabling GCM account filtering using a global Git configuration example to avoid repeated authentication prompts. The enterprise header is a contextual cue, not verified identity; the moving external configuration link is not reviewed here. The global-setting example was not executed and supplies no project authority to change credentials or configuration.

The fragment gives a placeholder file-scoped HEAD reset as an unstaging example. Exact file, HEAD existence, and index state require context; it is not whole-repository rollback guidance or evidence of recovery. No reset was executed.

The fragment names local Docker installation as a prerequisite and links to the vendor site. It supplies no supported version, daemon-readiness, security configuration, installation authority, or validated external-site contents. No installation or upstream setup script was executed.
